meta.name: dev-browser
meta.description: Browser automation with persistent page state. Use when users ask to navigate websites, fill forms, take screenshots, extract web data, test web apps, or automate browser workflows. Trigger phrases include "go to [url]", "click on", "fill out the form", "take a screenshot", "scrape", "automate", "test the website", "log into", or any browser interaction request.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动操作浏览器,完成打开网页、填表、截图与取数等重复流程
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常要在网页上重复点按、填表、登录或抓取数据
copy.tagline_en: Drive a browser automatically to open pages, fill forms, take screenshots and pull data
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you repeat clicks, forms or data pulls on websites

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会自己开浏览器干活:打开网址、点击、填表、截图、抓取网页数据、自动化操作;页面状态在多次脚本运行之间保留,可分步把流程做完。
howto.when: 当你要求打开某个网址、点击或填表、截图等任何浏览器操作时会接管;不确定用哪种模式时会先问你。

say.note: 会启动浏览器并返回截图

say.text: 登录这个网站,帮我填完表单
say.note: 需先装扩展连上你自己的 Chrome

say.text: 把这个页面的标题和链接抓下来
say.note: 返回抓取到的页面数据

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude can drive a browser itself: open URLs, click, fill forms, take screenshots, scrape web data, and automate flows. Page state persists across script runs, so a workflow can be done step by step.
howto.when_en: It takes over when you ask to open a URL, click or fill a form, take a screenshot, or any other browser interaction; it asks which mode to use if unclear.

say_en.text: Open example.com and take a screenshot
say_en.note: Launches the browser and returns the shot

say_en.text: Log into this site and fill out the form
say_en.note: Needs the extension connected to your Chrome

say_en.text: Scrape the titles and links from this page
